opinion.title: Life Better Today
opinion.topic: Quality of Life: Past vs Present
opinion.question: 'Life is better today than it was 100 years ago.' Do you agree?

styles.default:
Nowadays, there is considerable debate about whether life today is better than in the past. Hence, I would like to present my views on this issue. From my point of view, modern life is significantly better due to remarkable advances in health, entertainment and communication.

I firmly believe that healthcare plays an essential role in improving our lives. This is because diseases that once killed millions can now be treated effectively. For example, vaccines have eliminated deadly illnesses like polio and smallpox.

Another point that supports my view is that entertainment options have expanded enormously. This is because streaming platforms provide unlimited access to films and music instantly. For instance, we can enjoy any content from home at any time.

A further reason is that technology has transformed how we communicate globally. Video calls allow families to stay connected across continents daily. While some argue this causes stress, I believe the benefits outweigh any drawbacks.

All things considered, I am convinced that life today is much better than a century ago. Improvements in health, entertainment and technology demonstrate remarkable human progress.
styles.alternative1:

In my view, contemporary life offers substantial improvements, particularly regarding healthcare, entertainment and communication technology.

I am convinced that medical advances represent the most important improvement in modern life. This is because illnesses that previously caused widespread death are now preventable or curable. To illustrate, vaccination programmes have virtually eradicated diseases like smallpox and polio.

A further reason is that entertainment possibilities have grown tremendously over recent decades. This is because digital services offer instant access to countless films, shows and music. For example, streaming platforms let us watch anything we want whenever convenient.

I also feel strongly that communication technology has revolutionized how people stay in touch. Modern technology enables families separated by vast distances to video call daily. Although critics claim constant connectivity creates pressure, I would argue staying connected provides enormous benefits.

In conclusion, I strongly believe life has improved dramatically over the past century. Advances in medicine, entertainment and communication show significant progress.

opinion.title: Work: Money vs Enjoyment
opinion.question: Is it better to earn a lot of money or to enjoy your job?
writingPoints: how much time is spent at work
the type of work which is done
job satisfaction and mental health (your own idea)

styles.default:
There is a growing recognition that work is an essential part of modern life. In recent times, there has been considerable debate about job satisfaction versus high salaries. Therefore, it is vital we analyse the benefits and drawbacks of both options.

One positive aspect of earning a high salary is financial security and stability. This is because well-paid workers can afford comfortable lifestyles and support their families. For example, they can pay for quality healthcare and education. Another strong point is that we spend nearly a third of our lives working, so earning good money makes those hours worthwhile.

While there are many advantages to high salaries, job satisfaction matters greatly too. The key disadvantage of focusing only on money is that personal happiness suffers considerably. For instance, boring or stressful jobs often lead to unhappiness regardless of salary.

In addition, mental health is significantly affected by job satisfaction. This is because unfulfilling work can cause burnout, anxiety and depression.

To sum up, both money and enjoyment have clear advantages. Finding work that provides both purpose and reasonable income would be the ideal solution.
styles.alternative1:
It is a well-established fact that work plays a central role in our daily lives. Nowadays, many people debate whether earning lots of money or enjoying your job is more important. Hence, it is vital to analyse the benefits and drawbacks of each.

The main advantage of high-paying jobs is that they provide excellent financial security. This is because people with good salaries can afford better housing, holidays and lifestyle choices. For instance, they rarely worry about paying bills or unexpected expenses. Apart from that, considering we spend approximately one-third of our lives at work, good pay feels like fair compensation.

Despite these benefits, enjoying your work brings important advantages too. The argument against chasing money alone is that it damages happiness and life satisfaction. For example, people in dull or high-pressure jobs feel miserable even when earning excellent salaries.

Besides, job satisfaction has serious effects on mental wellbeing. This is because unrewarding work leads to stress-related illness and emotional exhaustion.

On the whole, both high earnings and job enjoyment offer real benefits. The ideal situation combines meaningful work with adequate financial rewards.
styles.alternative2:

The main argument in favour of earning excellent money is achieving financial stability and freedom. This is because high earners can provide comfortable homes and opportunities for their families. To illustrate, they access better schools, medical care and retirement security. It is also worth noting that since work occupies roughly a third of our waking hours, earning well makes this time investment worthwhile.

Although high salaries have benefits, workplace happiness also deserves serious consideration. The obvious drawback of prioritizing salary above all else is reduced personal wellbeing. As an example, many well-paid professionals in boring roles report feeling deeply unhappy.

Besides, mental health depends heavily on finding fulfilling employment. This is because dissatisfying jobs frequently cause burnout and depression. Therefore, choosing meaningful work protects your psychological health.

All things considered, salary and satisfaction both provide significant advantages. Combining enjoyable work with decent pay represents the best outcome.

opinion.title: Saving Endangered Animals
opinion.question: Should we do everything possible to save endangered animals?
writingPoints: the kind of animals in danger

styles.default:
In recent years, protecting endangered animals has attracted increasing attention from the public and environmental experts worldwide. Consequently, I intend to set out my personal view of this issue. It appears that we should do everything possible to save them for future generations.

What matters most to me is that many magnificent species are currently in serious danger of extinction. This is largely because hunting and habitat destruction have reduced their numbers drastically. For example, tigers, rhinos and elephants face critical threats.

I also feel strongly that there are compelling reasons to protect these animals. This is because every species plays vital roles in maintaining natural balance. For instance, bees pollinate crops that humans depend on for food. Consequently, losing animal species threatens our own survival too.

An additional consideration is that ecosystem balance depends entirely on biodiversity. This is because each animal contributes to complex food chains. For example, wolves control deer populations and protect forests. Therefore, protecting wildlife maintains environmental stability for everyone.

In conclusion, I firmly believe endangered animals must be protected urgently. Conservation benefits both nature and humanity significantly.
styles.alternative1:

An additional consideration is that protecting endangered animals makes sense for important practical reasons. This is because all creatures perform essential functions within nature. As an example, bees pollinate the plants that produce much of our food supply.

Another point that supports my view is that biodiversity is absolutely essential for healthy ecosystems. This is because animals form interconnected relationships in food webs. For instance, predators like wolves keep herbivore numbers balanced, preventing forest damage.

To sum up, it is important to acknowledge that protecting endangered species should be an urgent priority. Wildlife conservation protects both natural ecosystems and human interests.

opinion.title: Friends vs Family
opinion.question: Which is more important – friends or family?
writingPoints: who will help you when you have problems

styles.default:
It is often argued that relationships are essential to our happiness and wellbeing. In recent times, there has been considerable debate about the value of friendships compared with family ties. Therefore, it is vitally important to consider the advantages and disadvantages of both.

The main argument in favour of friends is that they provide enjoyment and shared interests. This is because we choose friends who share our hobbies, tastes and values. For example, teenagers select friends to socialise and have fun with.

While there are many advantages to friendships, family provides stronger support during difficult times. The key disadvantage of relying only on friends is that they may not always help during serious problems. Yet, family members typically offer unconditional support during crises without hesitation.

Furthermore, different relationships matter at different life stages. This is because teenagers often prioritise friends, while adults tend to value family more. Consequently, both types of relationships serve important purposes throughout our lives.

On the whole, both friends and family are extremely valuable. Family support proves more reliable, but both contribute significantly to our happiness.

opinion.title: Environment & Pollution
opinion.question: Do you think the world's pollution problems can be solved?

styles.default:
Nowadays, pollution has become an increasingly serious problem affecting the entire planet. It is widely recognised that pollution damages health and the environment significantly. Hence, it is vital to explore practical solutions to the main problems and explore practical solutions.

First of all, transport causes significant air pollution in cities worldwide. This is because millions of vehicles produce harmful emissions every single day. For example, major cities suffer from dangerous levels of smog.

Besides, rivers and seas are being contaminated by industrial waste and plastic. This happens because factories release toxic chemicals into waterways carelessly. For instance, countless marine animals die from plastic pollution annually. Consequently, entire ecosystems are being destroyed.

Nevertheless, renewable energy offers a very promising solution. This is because solar and wind power produce no harmful emissions whatsoever. For example, countries investing in clean energy report significantly improved air quality. If such measures were implemented globally, pollution could be reduced dramatically.

To sum up, I believe pollution can be addressed effectively through determined action. Combining cleaner transport, stricter regulations and renewable energy will protect our planet.

opinion.title: Fashion Industry
opinion.question: Does the fashion industry have a bad effect on people's lives?

styles.default:
The fashion industry has a significant and growing influence on modern society. Therefore, this essay will make clear where I stand on this issue. Because of this, there is considerable debate about whether its effects are positive or negative. I firmly believe the fashion industry creates several serious problems for people.

To start with, I believe that pressure to look fashionable damages people's confidence and self-image. This is because advertisements constantly promote unrealistic beauty standards. For example, many teenagers feel inadequate trying desperately to follow the latest trends.

An additional consideration is that fashionable clothing is often extremely expensive for ordinary families. This is because designer brands charge premium prices for trendy items each season. For instance, families feel pressured to buy expensive branded products unnecessarily.

Another point that supports my view is that fast fashion damages the environment significantly. This is because cheap, disposable clothing creates enormous amounts of waste globally. For example, millions of tonnes of unwanted clothes end up in landfills annually.

All things considered, I firmly believe the fashion industry has damaging negative effects. It creates pressure, encourages overspending and harms the environment badly.

Another point that supports my view is that trendy fashion items carry excessively high price tags for most people. This is because popular brands demand huge amounts for clothing that quickly goes out of style. As an example, ordinary families experience pressure purchasing overpriced designer items.

A further reason is that fast fashion production causes severe environmental destruction. This occurs because throwaway clothing generates massive quantities of pollution and waste worldwide. For instance, countless tons of discarded garments pollute landfills every year.

In conclusion, I strongly believe fashion causes more harm than good. It damages self-esteem, creates financial problems and destroys the environment.

opinion.title: Technology & Social Interaction

styles.default:
It is widely recognised that technology has transformed modern communication completely. It is often argued that digital communication has both positive and negative effects on social interaction. Hence, it is vital to analyse the arguments on both sides.

The main advantage of technology is connecting people instantly across vast distances. This is because social media platforms allow communication with anyone worldwide. For example, families can video call relatives abroad daily and share special moments. As a result, maintaining relationships across distances becomes much easier.

While there are many advantages, technology can reduce meaningful face-to-face interaction. The key disadvantage of smartphones is that people often stare at screens instead of talking. For instance, families frequently sit together in restaurants without actually conversing. Consequently, genuine social skills may decline over time.

Yet, technology greatly benefits long-distance relationships. This is because couples and friends separated by distance can stay closely connected through regular video calls and messaging. For example, this maintains bonds that letters never could achieve.

On the whole, technology has both significant benefits and drawbacks. It enhances communication when used responsibly alongside real-world interaction.

For example, busy professionals can order items late at night after work. As a result, shopping becomes far more efficient. What is more, online prices are often considerably lower.

In conclusion, both shopping methods have clear advantages. Combining online convenience with supporting local shops would be ideal.

opinion.title: Online Learning
opinion.question: Is online learning better than traditional classroom learning?

styles.default:
In recent times, online learning has become increasingly widespread across all educational levels. It is often argued that both online and traditional classroom learning have significant advantages. Therefore, it is vitally important to consider the advantages and disadvantages of each approach carefully.

The main argument in favour of online learning is its exceptional flexibility and accessibility. This is because students can study anytime and anywhere with internet access. For example, learners can access recorded lessons at times that suit their personal schedules.

While there are many advantages, classrooms provide valuable face-to-face interaction. The key disadvantage of online learning is significantly limited social contact with teachers and classmates. A major drawback is that students miss real discussions, friendships and immediate feedback. Consequently, learning online can feel quite isolating for many students.

What is more, online learning requires strong self-discipline and personal motivation. This is because students must organise themselves effectively without direct teacher supervision. For instance, many students struggle with procrastination when studying alone at home.

On the whole, both learning methods have significant advantages and challenges. Combining online flexibility with classroom interaction may prove most effective overall.

Despite these benefits, traditional classrooms deliver important personal interaction. The argument against digital education is severely reduced face-to-face contact with instructors and peers. One serious concern is that online students lose authentic conversations, social connections and instant guidance.

In addition, succeeding online demands considerable self-control and drive. This is because learners must manage their time and progress independently. As an example, numerous students face procrastination challenges without classroom structure.

All things considered, both educational approaches present important advantages and difficulties. Blending online convenience with in-person engagement might work best.

opinion.title: Pets and Mental Wellbeing
opinion.question: Do pets improve people's mental health and wellbeing?

styles.default:
Nowadays, millions of people keep pets as part of their daily lives. Hence, I would like to present my views on this issue. It is widely recognised that animals can significantly affect human health and happiness. I firmly believe that pets genuinely improve people's mental wellbeing.

My first reason for thinking so is that companionship is one of the greatest benefits pets provide. This is because animals offer unconditional affection and a constant, comforting presence.

Another point that supports my view is that caring for a pet creates a meaningful sense of purpose and routine. This is because animals depend on their owners for food and exercise.

A further reason is that pets are widely known to relieve stress. This is because stroking an animal lowers blood pressure and reduces anxiety. While some argue that pets are expensive, I believe the benefits clearly outweigh the costs.

To sum up, I am convinced that pets have a genuinely positive impact on mental health. The companionship, routine and stress relief they provide make animals enormously valuable.
styles.alternative1:

A further reason is that caring for a pet creates beneficial structure and purpose. This is because animals need regular feeding and exercise, encouraging healthy routines. As an example, dog owners who walk their pets daily build physical activity into their lives.

I also feel strongly that science confirms that animals effectively reduce stress. This is because interacting with pets triggers calming hormones such as oxytocin. Although critics highlight ownership costs, I would argue the mental health benefits justify these.

On the whole, I strongly believe pets contribute enormously to wellbeing. The companionship, routine and stress relief animals provide are of genuine and lasting value.
